sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "invoice_lines"."invoice_id" AS e, "customers"."country" AS g, SUM("invoice_lines"."unit_price") AS m1 FROM "invoice_lines" JOIN "invoices" ON "invoices"."id" = "invoice_lines"."invoice_id" JOIN "customers" ON "customers"."id" = "invoices"."customer_id" GROUP BY "invoice_lines"."invoice_id", "customers"."country"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of price charged per unit sold per invoices within customers.country (additive)
share of the g total of total of price charged per unit sold (g level)
rank within the group by total of price charged per unit sold, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "invoice_lines"."invoice_id" AS e, "customers"."country" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "invoice_lines" JOIN "invoices" ON "invoices"."id" = "invoice_lines"."invoice_id" JOIN "customers" ON "customers"."id" = "invoices"."customer_id" GROUP BY "invoice_lines"."invoice_id", "customers"."country"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3

rank within the group by number of invoice_lines records, keep the top 3
